phases.name: Maintenance Mode (perpetual sentinel)
phases.description: Not a development phase. Activates when no pending dev phase exists or when manually triggered. Never marked done.
tasks: Check GitHub Issues for bug reports or feature requests
Run go build ./... && go test ./... to verify project health
Review and merge dependabot PRs if safe
Fix reported issues and push patches (tag v1.x.y)
Upstream sync: compare upstream_commits hashes, port relevant changes
Check 9router open-sse/providers/registry/ for new providers or baseUrl changes
If no action needed: report 'no pending work' and exit

phases.name: Core Infrastructure & Database Layer

phases.name: Provider & Connection Management
phases.summary: Provider nodes repo, account fallback (cooldown + exponential backoff + model locks), priority-based credential selection, connection status, provider CRUD.

phases.name: Model Resolution & Combos
phases.summary: Model string parsing, alias resolution, combo system (fallback + round-robin + sticky), model availability, combo CRUD, unit tests.

phases.name: OpenAI-Compatible API Surface
phases.summary: /v1/chat/completions + /v1/messages + /v1/models + /v1/embeddings, middleware chain, SSE streaming proxy, format translation (OpenAI/Claude/Gemini), usage extraction, integration tests.

phases.name: Dashboard Panel System
phases.summary: CLI params + env vars, go:embed panel serving (local dir > downloaded cache > embedded), dist.zip support.

phases.name: Authentication & API Keys
phases.summary: HMAC-signed API key generation/validation, Bearer middleware, cookie-based dashboard session auth, login/logout.

phases.name: Usage Tracking & Observability
phases.summary: Usage history repo, token extraction (stream + non-stream), daily aggregation, request details, /api/usage/* endpoints.

phases.name: Dashboard Management API
phases.summary: Full REST API: providers CRUD, provider-nodes CRUD, combos, proxy-pools CRUD, /api/health.

phases.name: Advanced Features & Enhancements
phases.summary: OAuth token refresh (pre-check + on-401 retry), loop guard, termination prompt, proxy pool rotation, provider test, max_tokens clamping.

phases.name: Provider Transport Layer
phases.summary: Unified transport layer (internal/provider/transport.go): per-provider Transport{baseUrl,format,headers,urlSuffix,auth} resolved at proxy time, scheme-aware auth injection (bearer/raw/query) + hook framework (kimiHeaders X-Msh-*), dual-auth (kimi OAuth x-api-key vs apikey Bearer). Refactored chat (single+combo+messages) + connection test to use it. 15 transport tests incl. mock-upstream header validation for 6 auth shapes.

phases.name: OAuth Framework + Batch 1 (8 providers)
phases.summary: Token refresh engine: per-provider profiles (form/json, extra headers, error classification), singleflight dedup, per-provider lead times (codex 5d, iflow 24h). 8 providers: kimi (X-Msh-*), xai (OIDC discovery), claude (JSON), google (client_secret), qwen (resource_url), codex (unrecoverable detection), kiro (multi-path IDC/social), iflow (Basic auth). phases.name: Dynamic Model Catalog + Qoder OAuth/PAT Realignment
tasks: Scope decision (2026-08-11, user-directed): deep-adapt a curated provider set instead of all 112 — OAuth mainstream: claude, antigravity, codex, github, grok-cli, cursor, qoder, codebuddy-intl, kimi; key-or-public: opencode (built-in Bearer public pool + optional user key), openrouter (user key). Pure-apikey providers (tokenplan etc.) deferred to later phases.

Naming policy: display names follow VENDOR official names, not 9router labels; IDs may also diverge from 9router. Verified 2026-08-11: Grok Build (x.ai/build), Kimi Code / kimi-for-coding model id (kimi.com/code), Google Antigravity (antigravity.google), Tencent Cloud CodeBuddy (codebuddy.cn), Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Qoder, opencode/OpenCode Zen (opencode.ai), OpenRouter. Renames must keep DB compatibility: map old provider ids to new ones for existing connections (alias/migration).

Per-provider detail page rework (beyond generic Connections/Models/Settings): provider-specific layouts driven by registry capabilities — OAuth connect flow + token countdown, PAT/key entry with provider-specific hints (qoder pt-...), quota bar where supported, models tab. Include an inline model Q&A tester on the detail page (pick model → send prompt → show streamed answer + latency + usage), richer than upstream's connectivity-only Test.

Dynamic model catalog for the curated set: replace hardcoded registry_models.go id/name maps with live extraction from each provider's own endpoint (public models API, or OAuth-authenticated endpoint); static lists kept as offline fallback only; enrich meta end-to-end: context_length + max_output_tokens surfaced in catalog, /v1/models and panel.

Qoder fix: category free→oauth, authModes [oauth,apikey], PAT (pt-...) auth end-to-end — job-token exchange, SSE terminal-frame close, quota usage for both OAuth and PAT (port 9router@9c9dd7b1, @d433c0b2). Qoder stays a standalone product entry (its OAuth and PAT are both Qoder-native); its vendor's direct platform API is the Alibaba/Bailian line, already covered by existing entries alicode-intl (Alibaba Coding intl), alicode (Alibaba Coding CN, Bailian), alims-intl (Alibaba Studio/Model Studio) — no new entry needed.

Direct-API additions (2026-08-11, user-approved): dual-auth [oauth, apikey] on claude + codex entries (reuse Phase 34 dual-auth selection, parallel to existing xai/kimi); new GitHub Models API entry (models.github.com, PAT auth reusing GitHub OAuth token) — the only direct-API gap; Anthropic/OpenAI/Google (gemini+vertex)/Tencent direct APIs already covered as separate entries.

Registry pruning (2026-08-11, user-approved, supersedes Featured-flag idea): project not yet in production → no backward-compat needed → DELETE long-tail providers instead of tiering. Delete criteria: (1) upstream Hidden / service ended; (2) no transport verification in Phase 30-32; (3) duplicates of curated upstreams (e.g. opencode-go folds into opencode); (4) media providers (internal/media track) untouched. Keep list (~28): curated 13 (claude, codex, github, grok-cli, cursor, qoder, codebuddy-intl, kimi, antigravity, opencode, openrouter, glm, glm-cn) + direct APIs (anthropic, openai, gemini, vertex, tencent, xai, alicode-intl, alicode, alims-intl) + new github-models + E2E-verified (deepseek, cerebras, groq, nvidia, api-airforce) + brand pairs/quota-ported (codebuddy-cn, minimax, minimax-cn). Clean up registry tests, README matrix and related unit tests accordingly.

Detail page model-management features (2026-08-11, user-requested): (a) Refresh Models button per provider — calls the provider's own models endpoint (public or OAuth-authenticated) and updates the cached mapping, overriding the static fallback; (b) manual model naming — per-connection customModels CRUD in the Models tab for ids the API cannot resolve names for (customModels field already exists in /api/providers/{id}/models); (c) meta backfill — when a provider's models API lacks context_length/max_output, resolve via models.dev catalog (https://models.dev/api.json, fuzzy id match, already used upstream by mimo-free fetcher), with manual override for unmatched ids.
Curated set extended with glm + glm-cn (GLM Coding z.ai / Zhipu BigModel CN) as the apikey-provider detail-page exemplar, complementing the OAuth exemplars.

Intl/CN variant modeling (2026-08-11, user-approved): keep separate registry entries per region (distinct upstream URLs/auth/quota), but group by brand in UI via new registry fields Brand + Region (glm/glm-cn, minimax/minimax-cn, codebuddy-cn/intl, alicode/alicode-intl, alims-intl).
WebUI: provider-level detail route + make registry grid cards clickable (currently only connection cards navigate).
